title: Asiad: Sanchez shatters 50m backstroke national record, settles for fifth
summary: Kayla Sanchez shattered the Philippine women’s 50-meter backstroke national record after clocking 28.19 seconds to finish fifth in the final at the Tokyo Aquatics Center on Monday.
